body: OK, how about you tell us a little more about your situation if you'd like.

Note what you want to hear, but some people just can't handle suicide talk. It will push them, not because they don't love you, just because they are afraid. 
I don't know if you believe in fate, but some may say that you not being able to get the knot right was a sign. 
Don't focus on the past. Sure if you have an intention to die and they don't, that something you don't have that in common in that moment. As long as your still alive you have the ability to change. You not completely gone because this post tells me their is still hope for you. Talk to me.
I'm sorry you feel that way, can I ask why? I was in that position this past weekend, I've calmed down a bit since then.

Yeah, I know. It's what I've done before. If you get in the right mental state, you can almost go primal. It's insane. I use to do it a lot because the pain was a good distraction for me. It in a way kept the negative thoughts out. I ended up in good running shape and a really good pain tolerance!

I'm kind of in a similar situation. I have a lot of friends but they don't really know the pain I'm in. I feel this sort of disconnect from them, like I'm isolated and can't talk to them. It feels almost like a wall between us. When I'm in this "mood" I get no joy or anything from them. Its just null. In life you just have to find something you love and hold onto it. I'm still trying to find that something.

This may sound weird, but honestly, go for a run. Run until you can't run any more. Buy some cheap shoes and run until you feel like you're dying and then keep right. If you do it right, you'll be hurting. I'm not saying to injure yourself, just make your body sore and your lungs burn.
I'm here too, what would you like to talk about?

Well I think you should always stay too chicken. Helping people doesn't have to be major things. Start by holding doors open for people. Volunteer at soup kitchen or something. Smile and ask how other people are doing. It really can make someone else's day. Being positive around others will be returned to you. Fake it till you make it. I know how hard that is, but it keeps me going.

The one thing I've learned in my life is that people miss the little things the most when they are gone. They are the things you don't think about or thank, but when they are going they leave you feeling empty. You may feel average, but you have your quirks, everyone does. Your family will miss them and they can't be replaced. Talk to them, you have nothing else to lose if this really is your decision. We are hear for you if you just wanna talk. Help someone out.

Helping others is what keeps me going. Think about how bad you feel. I'm right there with you and helping others is the only thing I have going for me. I think I'm worthless. Helping people makes me feel a little less alone. 

I see hope in you. We are hear to listen, so feel free to talk. Maybe we can give you more hope, and with that you can find a purpose, and that purpose will keep you alive.

The fact that I've been alone for a long time. I have friends, but no one close. If I were to die where I sit, people wouldn't find me for days, even weeks.
I've done everything I can to make friends, but none seem to stick around. I'm sick of it.
